summary: Backend testing for iteration 16 — verified new/changed endpoints for the Auto Parts Store multi-tenant app: POST /api/scan-sticker (AI vision), Company Logo Library CRUD (/api/logos), Sticker Templates CRUD (/api/sticker-templates), multi-tenant isolation for both, and meta endpoints GET /api/categories & GET /api/companies. All 7 pytest tests passed (100% backend success). Notes: login endpoint returns {"access_token": ...} (NOT "token") — matches review spec. scan-sticker latency was ~1-3s on a synthetic 480x300 label image; response shape (aspect/part_number/lines/code/logo) is intact and normalized with defaults. Categories returns exactly 22 groups. Companies list contains Maruti Suzuki, Hyundai, Tata as required. Store-scoped isolation confirmed for both logos and sticker-templates (store B cannot see store A records).

minor.issue: Response 'store_id' field is included in POST /api/logos response but is null when the caller is a store owner? Not verified — POST response includes store_id=<store uuid> as expected. Minor: no explicit test for super_admin cross-store visibility on /api/logos (out of scope of review).

Both return 200 {ok:true} even when the id does not belong to the caller's store (store-scoped filter via sq() silently no-ops). Behavior is safe (no data leak) but a 404 on cross-store/unknown id would be more RESTful.

action_items: None from testing — all reviewed endpoints work as spec'd. Optional: consider returning 404 from DELETE endpoints on unknown/foreign ids for cleaner REST semantics.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1891 lines — should be split into routers (auth, meta, stickers, logos, etc.) for maintainability.

/api/scan-sticker: on emergentintegrations failure the exception message is surfaced verbatim (HTTPException(502, f"AI scan failed: {e}")) — could leak internal error details; consider a sanitized message and log the trace.
/api/sticker-templates and /api/logos POST endpoints accept arbitrarily large data_url / bg_data_url strings — consider a size cap (e.g. 2 MB) to protect Mongo document limits.
seed_data_creation: Registered a temporary isolation store TEST_isoB_<hex> via /api/auth/register per test module run; all TEST_* logos/templates are deleted in-test via finally blocks.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login endpoint returns access_token (not token). For AI /scan-sticker tests, use a real-looking PIL-generated JPEG with visible text so 'lines' array is non-empty. Fixture 'store_b' registers a fresh store to verify cross-tenant isolation; do not rely on hard-coded second store. sq() helper in server.py silently scopes queries by store_id — DELETE on foreign ids returns 200 but does nothing.
